name: cognitrace
description: Logs prompts sent to AI agents

cognitrace.enabled.description: Enable Cognitrace logging for this project. Disabled by default — turn it on from the Cognitrace icon in the Activity Bar.

cognitrace.userIdManualCode.description: Your user code, identifying who made each log entry. Required — entries are tagged "unknown" until it's set. Also doubles as the API key: setting it automatically enables remote sync to this build's configured Cognitrace API, no separate toggle needed.

cognitrace.saveLocally.description: Write log entries to .ai_log/ in this workspace. Independent of remote sync, which happens automatically once cognitrace.userIdManualCode is set — you can save locally, sync, both, or neither.

cognitrace.projectId.description: Which of your linked projects this workspace's log entries are tagged with. Set from the project dropdown in the Cognitrace panel; empty means the project is auto-detected from this folder instead.

scripts.pretest: yarn run compile-tests && yarn run compile && yarn run lint
